rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest candidate: chunk 8 line 64 "The plan read is a calibration move." — the exact compound 'plan read' is never used verbatim in chunks 1-7 (grep confirms), but chunks 3-7 (5 headings: Five things a good plan has / Three pressures / Two reads, paired / Find is easier than judge / Plan review is a high-leverage gate) are entirely the reading-and-reviewing-a-plan practice; a reader landing on chunk 8 has just spent five slides on exactly that activity, so 'the plan read' resolves as a natural label for what was just taught, not a forward or absent referent. Maintainer block line 77 pre-addresses this exact resolution ("Sequential deck read resolves ... the plan read from the preceding slide"), checked per dispatch-preamble maintainer-accept-note clause. Harm the rule prevents (reader stranded, no candidate referent) is absent: there is exactly one candidate and it was just built over 5 slides.
No chunk points at another file by position. All references (Horthy credit, 'aka context engineering') are inline and self-contained; no 'the opening lecture said' style pointer in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No 'the X you did/saw' construction anywhere in body — file has no backward-pointing beat references to check.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No guess-before-reveal construction in this file.
Every chunk (1-8) carries a self-sufficient claim or instruction of its own — e.g. chunk 2 (lines 16-25) is a full 30-second exercise with prompt and framing, not a bare wait-state bullet.

Checked all 8 headers against their chunk content: e.g. chunk 3 'Five things a good plan has' (line 27) is followed by exactly five bolded-handle bullets (lines 29-33); chunk 8's header names the ceiling claim the bullets then state (line 59 vs 63-67). No header is contradicted by its own content.

Scanned all 8 chunks for the five sub-items: no 'Not X. Not Y. Z.' construction; no anaphora/epistrophe triples; no self-grading superlatives ('high-leverage gate' at line 52 is a claim about mechanism, not a self-grading value-prop line like 'one of the most useful'); no number-with-retraction; no abstraction-noun stacks ('bounded-window reality'-style); no empty-leg verb triplets. All sub-items PASS.
